rules.description: A first run starts at sequence zero without causal parents.
Checkpoint/resume stays in the same run with one active parent and consecutive sequence.
Checkpoints may change scope; terminal scope must stay within its active parent.
Complete and abandon terminate their run; ordinary successors are refused.
A later run can supersede a terminal head, but cannot restart one active head.
Task/source/claim, code repository and branch remain fixed during a run; a PR may be added once but not changed.
rules.contractSection: Events and runs; SKILL.md: Resume, complete and commit

rules.description: Parent IDs must exist, be unique, and belong to the same task.
Every run has exactly one start, with unique event identity.
Every task needs a single frontier for committed validation, even for identical fingerprints.
A new reconciliation run references competing heads forming an antichain; it gives no coverage until completion.
Only a newly added complete single frontier contributes, never a stale or superseded completion.
Timestamps do not order events or select a winning frontier.
Separate tasks retain their own frontiers; one active task does not block another task completion.
rules.contractSection: Events and runs; SKILL.md: Conflicts and interruptions
